Alex: quick async — what I did: deployed small jwt rotation fix to staging, added debug logging for token bucket. Noticed 5xxs on /v1/edge during thinburst test at 11:22. Blockers: can't repro locally, need someone to eyeball gateway policy and auth middleware traces.

Maria: thanks. I'm pulling logs now. saw many 429 -> 502 cascade around 11:22 with upstream timeouts. Could be overload + slow healthcheck. Sharing query:

```
kubectl logs gw-0 -n prod --since=15m | grep '429\|502' | tail -n 20
```

Sam: I can try a canary rate bump + reduce per-route token bucket burst from 50 -> 30. Opening PR: #914. Will coordinate canary 2% -> 10%.

Alex: thx. Can you also add a temporary metric tag for `ratepolicy=shortstack-test` so we can filter? Also pinging @oncall-eng if rollout spikes.

deploy-bot: Started canary rollout gw-ratepolicy-shortstack PR#914 at 2% (id: canary-2024-04-05-02). Monitor: https://internal/rollouts/914

Tanya: heads up — I saw elevated latency in dedicated pool when similar tests ran yesterday; might be KV cache pressure. If we see >300ms token verify, abort canary.

Sam: noted. I'll include abort threshold 5xx > 1% or p50 latency > 200ms.

Alex: plan for today: monitor canary, collect APM traces, validate no auth regressions; if stable, promote by EOD. Blocker: need someone to review PR (small code + config). Maria? :pray:

Maria: reviewing now, should land in 30m.

Alex: cool. will follow up in an hour. :eyes:
